title: LongCat-Next: Native Multimodal MoE AI Model
summary: LongCat-Next is an any-to-any native multimodal model that unifies text, images, and audio into a shared set of discrete tokens. Developed by Meituan, it uses a Mixture-of-Experts architecture to perform seamless understanding and generation across diverse data types.
research_notes: Utilizes the DiNA (Discrete Native Autoregression) paradigm; technical details are documented in arXiv report 2603.27538.

evolution.summary: LongCat-Next evolved from the LongCat-Flash series, transitioning from language-first to a truly unified any-to-any paradigm. It incorporates the dNaViT visual tokenizer and supports low-latency voice cloning and high-fidelity media generation.
